fields.name: Tick
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1F01980 writes 0. bg3.exe+0x1F007A0 (ecl::timeline::MainMenuTimelineSystem, called from bg3.exe+0x761BB0 with the ls::GameTime as third argument) overwrites it, for every event entity of a played main-menu trigger, with '*(uint32 *)(GameTime + 0x10)' (fetch helper bg3.exe+0x1F023D0); the macOS MainMenuTimelineSystem::Update does the same store. ls::GameTime +0x10 is the unsigned frame counter: Toolkit CoreLib ls::GameTime::GameTime(double, float, unsigned int) stores the uint there and GetEstimatedPreviousTime writes it minus 1. So the request carries the tick it was raised on; consumer is a 'modified' query in bg3.exe+0x1D90140.

open_questions: The consumer in ecl::TimelineSystem (query with MainMenuActiveEventComponent, bg3.exe+0x1D90140) was not read; the name Tick is inferred from the value's source.
Never alive in the captures (main menu only).
second_pass: Settled: the only write (bg3.exe+0x1F007A0) copies the 4-byte uint at GameTime +0x10, which the Toolkit's ls::GameTime constructor shows to be the unsigned tick counter. Note: Script Extender's GameTime (Base/ExposedTypes.h) puts Ticks at +0xC and a double at +0x10, which disagrees with the Toolkit constructor (+0xC = 0, uint ticks at +0x10).
